caption: The drawing consists of a central large rectangular panel and three smaller rectangular panels around it, all set against a plain, off-white background. The central panel depicts a symmetrical arrangement of floral or leaf motifs, primarily in blue, with additional red elements. The blue motifs form curved, leafy shapes, while red elements appear as small flower-like clusters in the top and bottom center. There are black lines running irregularly through the central panel, simulating cracks on the surface. On either side of this central panel, two smaller vertical rectangles feature repeating blue leaf designs in a geometric pattern. Along the top, a horizontal rectangle shows two beige and brown flower-like or fruit objects with vertical stripes, each surrounded by blue leafy branches running horizontally. The predominant colors throughout the drawing are muted blue, light red, beige, and brown, all rendered on a light background.
title: Wall Stencil
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
